dataList.desc: ได้รับตัวตน
dataList.dlg: คุณจะครุ่นคิดสงสัยถึงประสงค์แห่งบทบัญญัติก็ได้นะคะ แต่คำถามนั่นจะไม่ส่งผลต่อการดำเนินการของมัน เพราะสิ่งเดียวที่คุณทำได้คือการน้อมปฏิบัติตามข้อความคำสั่งเด็ดขาดนั้น

dataList.desc: ทักทายยามเช้า
dataList.dlg: I drink a liter of juice in the morning and warm up before I set out to escort the Proxies. This Prescript has no defined time limit—thus, I remain in perpetual execution of it.

dataList.desc: ทักทายยามบ่าย
dataList.dlg:
... The appointed time has lapsed. The Prescript's deadline was until noon. ... It's unfortunate, but you were the fifth person who smiled at me among all the people I encountered yesterday, so I must proceed by severing your left earlobe.
Resistance is ill-advised. Such cases, with prevailing regularity, result in new Prescripts that dictate deeper and broader excision of the flesh.

dataList.desc: ทักทายยามเย็น
dataList.dlg:
"Split the nocturnal lights of the Backstreets thrice before 6 months pass." ... I have yet to determine the exact method of carrying out this Prescript.
And so each night, I pace the neon-lit alleys in nocturnal contemplation.

dataList.desc: สนทนา #1
dataList.dlg: It is said that the Will of the Prescript and the Will of the City are one and the same. Whether this is true or not, the Prescript's intent is not to be fathomed—just as my following the Prescript does not require Faust's understanding. The true value of things lies solely in undertaking and fulfilling the Prescript.

dataList.desc: สนทนา #2
dataList.dlg:
At times, the Prescript feels reminiscent of Faust. Through its Messengers, the Prescript busily wends its way through the City, as Faust once did in pursuit of curiosity.
But such moments must now be set aside. Follow where the Prescript leads, and the Will of the City shall reveal itself in due course.

dataList.desc: สนทนา #3
dataList.dlg:
Faust seems blind to the reality that the accumulation and interpretation of knowledge is ultimately futile within the City.
Perhaps that nescience explains their attempts to seize my access rights... that failed at every turn. That, too, must be the Will of the Prescript.

dataList.desc: สนทนาหลังการผูกมัด 1
dataList.dlg:
The index finger points; as does the Prescript that indicates the path we must tread. That is what gives the Index its name.
None of this is mere happenstance. Even should individuals unite in defiance of the Prescript, such resistance falls within the Will of the Prescript.

dataList.desc: สนทนาหลังการผูกมัด 2
dataList.dlg:
To be appointed a Proxy or a Messenger holds no particular appeal for Faust; such things are not for Faust to decide.
Cutting these people down, receiving the Prescript, assuming any role within the Index—it is all the same.

dataList.desc: อยู่เฉย
dataList.dlg: Hmm. Refraction of light through a polygonal mirror... This cannot be an appropriate interpretation of the Prescript to "split the lights."

dataList.desc: ผูกมัด
dataList.dlg: A new Prescript has arrived: "Behead seven dwellers of the Backstreets who resist when a blade touches their throat." The tally aligns—seven of you stand before me. I shall commence.

dataList.desc: เลือกเข้าทีม
dataList.dlg: The Prescript is received.

dataList.desc: เข้าด่าน
dataList.dlg: To where the Prescript points.

dataList.desc: ตรวจสอบตัวละครระหว่างการต่อสู้
dataList.dlg: การสนทนานั้นไม่ได้ขัดต่อบทบัญญัติค่ะ

dataList.desc: สั่งจู่โจม
dataList.dlg: ปฏิบัตตามคำสั่งของบทบัญญัติ ฟาดฟัน

dataList.desc: ศัตรูติดชะงัก
dataList.dlg: โปรดอดทนไว้ ยังต้องเฉือนคุณอีกห้ารอบค่ะ

dataList.desc: ติดชะงัก
สังหารศัตรู
dataList.dlg: เสร็จสิ้นแล้วค่ะ

dataList.desc: ตาย
dataList.dlg: บทบัญญัติสั่งให้... ตายเหรอคะ...? หากไม่ใช่... แล้วนี่คือประสงค์... ของใครกัน...?

dataList.desc: เช็คผ่าน
dataList.dlg: It is concluded.

dataList.desc: เช็คล้มเหลว
dataList.dlg: The Prescript has demanded this failure.

dataList.desc: ได้รับชัยชนะ
dataList.dlg: Those who have neglected to carry out the Prescript are being taken care of in order. The process is slightly delayed as I perform the following task: "Shear 663 strands of hair and enclose them in an envelope, to be deposited at Ticket Gate 3." There is no cause for concern.

dataList.desc: เงื่อนไข EX ผ่าน
dataList.dlg: The Prescript has been carried out. Its clarity made its execution simple and convenient. Though there were many who resisted, their defiance proved meaningless, as you have witnessed.

dataList.desc: พ่ายแพ้
dataList.dlg:
... I do not deem this a failure of the Prescript—it is I who have failed, and that, too, is part of the Prescript's design. I am but a speck that will fade from the City, and soon, another Proselyte or Proxy will arrive to take my place.
Such must be the direction to which the Prescript points.
